questions.question: Who is the main character of the story?
questions.explanation: The story follows the life of Ramanujan.

questions.question: Who in Cambridge receives a letter full of theorems without proofs?
questions.explanation: Hardy reads Ramanujan's letter in Trinity College.

questions.question: Which goddess does Ramanujan mention?
questions.explanation: The mother hears in a dream the voice of the goddess Namagiri.

questions.question: How old was Ramanujan when he died?
What does Ramanujan say about equations?
answers: They have no meaning unless they express a thought of God
questions.explanation: He repeats: an equation is meaningless if it does not express a thought of God.
